name: familiar-windows
description: Windows port of Familiar — a tray app that screenshots every few seconds, runs Windows OCR locally, post-processes with a bundled local LLM (or your own Ollama if you prefer), redacts secrets, and writes markdown into %USERPROFILE%\.familiar\ so local AI agents have ambient context. Supports single-monitor, per-monitor, and stitched multi-monitor capture. Zero prerequisites — ships with ripgrep and a small llamafile bundled.
author: JD Veer

scripts.predist: npm run rg:fetch && npm run llm:fetch
scripts.prepack: npm run rg:fetch && npm run llm:fetch

scripts-info.postinstall: Auto-fired by `npm install`. Rebuilds better-sqlite3 against Electron's Node ABI (143) instead of system Node's, otherwise the main process crashes at startup with NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatch.
scripts-info.rebuild: Manual version of postinstall. Re-run after upgrading Electron or when native modules misbehave.
scripts-info.dev: Run the app from source. Reads `main: src/main/index.js`, opens the tray icon, starts the capture loop.
scripts-info.icon:build: Regenerate src/assets/familiar.ico as a multi-resolution icon (16/24/32/48/64/128/256) from src/assets/familiar.png. Run after swapping the source PNG.
scripts-info.rg:fetch: Download a pinned ripgrep release and extract rg.exe into build/rg/ (idempotent).
scripts-info.llm:fetch: Download a pinned llamafile (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M, ~673 MiB) into build/llm/ (idempotent). This is the bundled fallback LLM used when no external Ollama is reachable.
scripts-info.predist: Auto-fires before `dist`. Ensures build/rg/ and build/llm/ are populated.
scripts-info.prepack: Same as predist, for the `pack` script.
scripts-info.dist: Build the real NSIS installer + portable zip into dist/ (installer ~800 MB with the bundled LLM).
scripts-info.pack: Build dist/win-unpacked/ only — skips installer compression. Useful for fast inspection of what the packaged app contains.
